fields.FIR_Description: A written complaint dated 2026-07-19 states that the complainant contributed to a local chit group, and after the organiser failed to pay the maturity amount of Rs. 8,00,000, contact was lost, on 2026-07-08 at about 10:15. Contact details given by the complainant, Buvaneswari Devi, include the number 9000000492. Padmini Raj (9000000032) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. The complainant alleged that Vasanth Mani may be involved and provided the mobile number 9000000382. Transaction details refer to the receiving account SYN-ACC-100007. Items referenced in the complaint: transaction records and a call detail reference. Records suggest a possible link with FIR-2026-00407, as the mobile number 9000000382 is associated with a suspect in both entries.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Chit contributions reportedly collected in cash and through transfers.
fields.Keywords: chit fund, financial fraud, mobile number, morning, witness, main street, transaction record, call detail
